examples.title: E-Commerce Ordering
examples.description: A multi-context domain with ordering and fulfillment bounded contexts connected by an event-driven flow with crossings and contracts.
examples.moment:
context "Ordering" [Core]

  aggregate "Order"
    identity orderId: UUID

    command PlaceOrder
      input customerId: UUID, items: OrderItem[]
      precondition orderNotPlaced: "Order has not already been placed"
      emits OrderPlaced

    command CancelOrder
      input orderId: UUID, reason: string
      precondition orderNotShipped: "Order must not have been shipped"
      emits OrderCancelled

    event OrderPlaced
      orderId: UUID
      customerId: UUID
      items: OrderItem[]
      placedAt: DateTime

    event OrderCancelled
      orderId: UUID
      reason: string
      cancelledAt: DateTime

  value-object OrderItem
    productId: UUID
    quantity: number
    unitPrice: Money

  invariant ORD-01 "Order must contain at least one item"
    scope Order

context "Fulfillment" [Supporting]

  aggregate "FulfillmentRequest"
    identity fulfillmentId: UUID

    command InitiateFulfillment
      input orderId: UUID, items: OrderItem[]
      emits FulfillmentInitiated

    event FulfillmentInitiated
      fulfillmentId: UUID
      orderId: UUID
      items: OrderItem[]
      initiatedAt: DateTime

  value-object OrderItem
    productId: UUID
    quantity: number
    unitPrice: Money

flow "order-placed"
  description "Order submission triggers fulfillment"

  lane ordering "Ordering" [Core]
  lane fulfillment "Fulfillment" [Supporting]

  moment "Order submission"
    ordering: PlaceOrder
    ordering: OrderPlaced crosses-to fulfillment via CustomerSupplier
      contract
        orderId: UUID [required]
        items: OrderItem[] [required]

  moment "Fulfillment initiation"
    fulfillment: InitiateFulfillment
      triggered-by OrderPlaced
    fulfillment: FulfillmentInitiated
examples.gherkin:
# Generated by @mmmnt/generate

@flow:order-placed
Feature: Order submission triggers fulfillment

  @context:Ordering @classification:Core
  Rule: Ordering [Core]

    Background:
      Given precondition "orderNotPlaced" holds:
        | Order has not already been placed |

    @happy-path
    Scenario: Order submission
      When Ordering executes PlaceOrder with:
        | customerId | <UUID>        |
        | items      | <OrderItem[]> |
      Then Ordering emits OrderPlaced

    @crossing
    Scenario: OrderPlaced crosses to Fulfillment
      Given Ordering has emitted OrderPlaced
      Then OrderPlaced crosses to Fulfillment via CustomerSupplier
      And the crossing contract contains:
        | orderId | UUID        | required |
        | items   | OrderItem[] | required |

  @context:Fulfillment @classification:Supporting
  Rule: Fulfillment [Supporting]

    Scenario: Fulfillment initiation
      Given OrderPlaced has been received
      When Fulfillment executes InitiateFulfillment
        triggered-by OrderPlaced
      Then Fulfillment emits FulfillmentInitiated

  @invariant
  Scenario: Invariant ORD-01 — Order must contain at least one item
    When Ordering executes PlaceOrder with:
      | items | [] |
    Then the command is rejected
    And invariant ORD-01 is violated

# Order Placement — Specification Document

*Generated by @mmmnt/generate*

## At a Glance

| Context     | Classification | Aggregates | Commands | Events |
|-------------|---------------|------------|----------|--------|
| Ordering    | Core          | 1          | 2        | 2      |
| Fulfillment | Supporting    | 1          | 1        | 1      |

## Context Map

```mermaid
graph LR
  Ordering["Ordering\n[Core]"]
  Fulfillment["Fulfillment\n[Supporting]"]
  Ordering -->|CustomerSupplier| Fulfillment
```

## Flow: order-placed

> Order submission triggers fulfillment

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant O as Ordering [Core]
  participant F as Fulfillment [Supporting]

  Note over O: Order submission
  O->>O: PlaceOrder
  O->>F: OrderPlaced (CustomerSupplier)
  Note over O,F: contract: orderId, items

  Note over F: Fulfillment initiation
  F->>F: InitiateFulfillment (triggered-by OrderPlaced)
  F->>F: FulfillmentInitiated
```

## Context Boundaries

| Source    | Target      | Event       | Relationship     | Required Fields    |
|-----------|-------------|-------------|-----------------|--------------------|
| Ordering  | Fulfillment | OrderPlaced | CustomerSupplier | orderId, items     |

## Domain Model

### Ordering [Core]

**Order** (identity: orderId)
- PlaceOrder → OrderPlaced
- CancelOrder → OrderCancelled
- Invariant ORD-01: Order must contain at least one item

### Fulfillment [Supporting]

**FulfillmentRequest** (identity: fulfillmentId)
- InitiateFulfillment → FulfillmentInitiated

examples.title: Veterinary Clinic Visit
examples.description: A complex multi-context domain with sagas, policies, branches, and cross-context flows demonstrating the full power of temporal DDD modeling.
examples.moment:
context "Reception" [Core]
  description "Manages patient check-in and registration"

  aggregate "PatientIntake"
    identity intakeId: UUID

    command CheckInPatient
      input patientId: UUID, ownerName: string,
            appointmentType: string
      precondition appointmentExists:
        "Patient must have a scheduled appointment"
      emits PatientCheckedIn

    command SubmitValidateIntake
      input intakeFormId: UUID, patientId: UUID
      precondition intakeFormComplete:
        "Intake form must be fully completed"
      emits IntakeValidated

    command RegisterPatientIntake
      input validatedIntakeId: UUID, patientId: UUID
      emits PatientIntakeRegistered

    event PatientCheckedIn
      intakeId: UUID
      patientId: UUID
      ownerName: string
      checkedInAt: DateTime

    event IntakeValidated
      intakeId: UUID
      patientId: UUID
      validationResult: string
      validatedAt: DateTime

    event PatientIntakeRegistered
      intakeId: UUID
      patientId: UUID
      name: string
      species: string
      registeredAt: DateTime

  invariant REC-01
    "Patient must have valid identification"
    scope PatientIntake

context "Clinical" [Core]
  description "Handles triage, diagnosis, and treatment"

  aggregate "VisitRecord"
    identity visitId: UUID

    command CompleteTriage
      input patientId: UUID, weight: string,
            temperature: string, chiefComplaint: string
      precondition patientRegistered:
        "Patient must be registered through intake"
      emits TriageCompleted

    command PerformDualVetAssessment
      input visitId: UUID, triageResults: TriageResults
      emits DualVetAssessmentCompleted

    event TriageCompleted
      visitId: UUID
      patientId: UUID
      chiefComplaint: string
      urgency: string
      completedAt: DateTime

    event DualVetAssessmentCompleted
      visitId: UUID
      agreement: boolean
      assessedAt: DateTime

  saga VisitLifecycle
    trigger PatientIntakeRegistered
    states Triaging -> Diagnosing -> Treating -> Complete
    compensation "Cancel visit and release appointment slot"
    timeout visitTimeout

  policy TriageOnIntakeRegistered
    trigger PatientIntakeRegistered
    action "Begin triage process for registered patient"
    chains-to CompleteTriage

  policy AssessOnTriageCompleted
    trigger TriageCompleted
    action "Initiate dual-vet assessment after triage"
    chains-to PerformDualVetAssessment

flow "scheduled-visit-happy-path"
  description "Full lifecycle: check-in through triage and assessment with branching"

  lane reception "Reception" [Core]
  lane clinical "Clinical" [Core]
  branch-lane intakeFailure "Intake Failure" [Terminal]
  branch-lane vetDisagreement "Vet Disagreement" [Terminal]

  moment "Patient check-in"
    reception: CheckInPatient
    reception: PatientCheckedIn

  moment "Intake validation"
    reception: SubmitValidateIntake
      triggered-by PatientCheckedIn
    reception: IntakeValidated

  moment "Intake validation outcome" [branch]
    when valid
      reception: RegisterPatientIntake
        triggered-by IntakeValidated
      reception: PatientIntakeRegistered crosses-to clinical
        via CustomerSupplier
        contract
          patientId: UUID [required]
          name: string [required]
          species: string [required]
    when invalid
      intakeFailure: IntakeValidated [terminal]

  moment "Triage"
    clinical: CompleteTriage
      triggered-by PatientIntakeRegistered
    clinical: TriageCompleted

  moment "Dual-vet assessment"
    clinical: PerformDualVetAssessment
      triggered-by TriageCompleted
    clinical: DualVetAssessmentCompleted

  moment "Assessment agreement" [branch]
    when agree
      clinical: RecordClinicalObservation
        triggered-by DualVetAssessmentCompleted
    when disagree
      vetDisagreement: DualVetAssessmentCompleted [terminal]

# Generated by @mmmnt/generate

@flow:scheduled-visit-happy-path
Feature: Scheduled veterinary visit — happy path

  @context:Reception @classification:Core
  Rule: Reception [Core]

    Background:
      Given precondition "appointmentExists" holds:
        | Patient must have a scheduled appointment |

    @happy-path
    Scenario: Patient check-in
      When Reception executes CheckInPatient
      Then Reception emits PatientCheckedIn

    Scenario: Intake validation
      Given PatientCheckedIn has been emitted
      When Reception executes SubmitValidateIntake
        triggered-by PatientCheckedIn
      Then Reception emits IntakeValidated

    @happy-path @crossing
    Scenario: Intake valid — registration crosses to Clinical
      Given IntakeValidated with result "valid"
      When Reception executes RegisterPatientIntake
      Then Reception emits PatientIntakeRegistered
      And PatientIntakeRegistered crosses to Clinical via CustomerSupplier
      And the crossing contract contains:
        | patientId | UUID   | required |
        | name      | string | required |
        | species   | string | required |

    @failure-path @terminal
    Scenario: Intake invalid — terminal
      Given IntakeValidated with result "invalid"
      Then flow terminates at Intake Failure

  @context:Clinical @classification:Core
  Rule: Clinical [Core]

    Scenario: Triage
      Given PatientIntakeRegistered has been received
      When Clinical executes CompleteTriage
        triggered-by PatientIntakeRegistered
      Then Clinical emits TriageCompleted

    Scenario: Dual-vet assessment
      Given TriageCompleted has been emitted
      When Clinical executes PerformDualVetAssessment
      Then Clinical emits DualVetAssessmentCompleted

    @happy-path
    Scenario: Vets agree — continue observation
      Given DualVetAssessmentCompleted with agreement true
      Then Clinical proceeds to RecordClinicalObservation

    @failure-path @terminal
    Scenario: Vets disagree — terminal
      Given DualVetAssessmentCompleted with agreement false
      Then flow terminates at Vet Disagreement

  @saga
  Scenario: VisitLifecycle saga
    Given PatientIntakeRegistered triggers VisitLifecycle
    Then saga progresses: Triaging → Diagnosing → Treating → Complete
    And compensation is "Cancel visit and release appointment slot"

  @policy
  Scenario: TriageOnIntakeRegistered policy
    Given PatientIntakeRegistered is emitted
    Then policy chains to CompleteTriage
examples.specDoc:
# Scheduled Veterinary Visit — Specification Document

*Generated by @mmmnt/generate*

## At a Glance

| Context    | Classification | Aggregates | Commands | Events | Sagas | Policies |
|------------|---------------|------------|----------|--------|-------|----------|
| Reception  | Core          | 1          | 3        | 3      | 0     | 0        |
| Clinical   | Core          | 1          | 2        | 2      | 1     | 2        |

## Context Map

```mermaid
graph LR
  Reception["Reception\n[Core]"]
  Clinical["Clinical\n[Core]"]
  IntakeFailure["Intake Failure\n[Terminal]"]
  VetDisagreement["Vet Disagreement\n[Terminal]"]
  Reception -->|CustomerSupplier| Clinical
  Reception -.->|terminal| IntakeFailure
  Clinical -.->|terminal| VetDisagreement
```

## Flow: scheduled-visit-happy-path

> Full lifecycle: check-in through triage and assessment with branching

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant R as Reception [Core]
  participant C as Clinical [Core]
  participant IF as Intake Failure [Terminal]
  participant VD as Vet Disagreement [Terminal]

  Note over R: Patient check-in
  R->>R: CheckInPatient → PatientCheckedIn

  Note over R: Intake validation
  R->>R: SubmitValidateIntake (triggered-by PatientCheckedIn)

  alt when valid
    R->>C: PatientIntakeRegistered (CustomerSupplier)
    Note over R,C: contract: patientId, name, species
  else when invalid
    R--xIF: IntakeValidated [terminal]
  end

  Note over C: Triage
  C->>C: CompleteTriage (triggered-by PatientIntakeRegistered)

  Note over C: Dual-vet assessment
  C->>C: PerformDualVetAssessment

  alt when agree
    C->>C: RecordClinicalObservation
  else when disagree
    C--xVD: DualVetAssessmentCompleted [terminal]
  end
```

## Sagas

### VisitLifecycle
- **Trigger**: PatientIntakeRegistered
- **States**: Triaging → Diagnosing → Treating → Complete
- **Compensation**: Cancel visit and release appointment slot
- **Timeout**: visitTimeout

## Policies

| Policy                    | Trigger                    | Chains To                  |
|---------------------------|---------------------------|----------------------------|
| TriageOnIntakeRegistered  | PatientIntakeRegistered    | CompleteTriage             |
| AssessOnTriageCompleted   | TriageCompleted            | PerformDualVetAssessment   |
